scope: Index of retained historical evidence and source review; no new target execution.
interpretation: Each row is an indexed scenario, not an additional test or claim of complete coverage. Status describes the evidence within its stated limits.

rows.invariant: A revoked credential must not re-enter the tool body.
rows.scenario: Reject a protected call on an existing SSE connection.
rows.oracle: Server HTTP response and tool-execution counter.
rows.limits: Owned synthetic credentials and local server; not a test of every production authorization policy.

rows.invariant: A rejected request should promptly notify its waiting RPC.
rows.scenario: Rejected call without an RPC deadline; compare release control, PR base and PR head.
rows.oracle: RPC completion/error and elapsed time, independently of server denial.
rows.observed: Base/release still pending at the two-second observation bound; tested PR head returned MCPError -32603 in about 0.016 seconds.
rows.limits: Head 66a9285 versus base a4f4ccd; not an infinite-wait proof, entire-PR certification or shipped-release claim.

rows.invariant: An explicit deadline should bound the response wait.
rows.scenario: Same rejected call with a 0.5-second RPC deadline.
rows.observed: Baseline ended with request timeout; PR head returned a transport-related error promptly.
rows.limits: A timeout bounds waiting but does not repair error propagation.

rows.invariant: The selected follow-up should work after normal reauthorization.
rows.scenario: New valid token for the same registered client after the rejected call.
rows.oracle: Follow-up success on the existing connection.
rows.observed: Tested head follow-up succeeded; baseline reported Connection closed.
rows.limits: Harness cancellation precedes baseline recovery; it is not isolated evidence about 401 alone.

rows.boundary: One pending call -> unrelated client / event loop
rows.invariant: One pending operation should not block the selected independent work.
rows.scenario: Run a healthy independent call and heartbeat while one rejected RPC is pending.
rows.observed: Both controls completed in the bounded fixture.
rows.limits: One failing operation at a time; no load, exhaustion or consumer-runtime test.

rows.invariant: If a deployment requires serialized refresh, sharing storage must not be mistaken for a shared live lock.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Separate live OAuth contexts sharing storage did not serialize the first colliding refresh; one reauthorized, later cycles used different pairs.
rows.limits: Owned provider rotation policy; no exactly-once guarantee established

rows.invariant: If atomic state is required, an interrupted save must not mix token generations.
rows.scenario: Controlled exit between token-pair and expiry writes.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Controlled process exit between token and expiry writes left new token pair with prior expiry; SQLite valid; explicit retry repaired test state.
rows.limits: Historical controlled interruption, not proof of natural exploit or automatic recovery

rows.invariant: The selected supported public-client revocation flow should be accepted.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Earlier public-client revocation without client_secret returned invalid_request; confidential-client revocation worked.
rows.limits: Distinct from later server-401 SSE error feedback; no auth bypass

rows.invariant: The chosen owner-only deployment policy should exclude additional OS identities.
rows.scenario: Inspect inherited Windows DACL with modeled SIDs.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Inherited Windows DACL granted extra modeled SIDs access contrary to the selected owner-only deployment policy.
rows.limits: No real second-user process, key-access or plaintext disclosure established
